name: Ukrposhta
description: Ukrposhta (Укрпошта) API for business customers in Ukraine: shipment tracking, shipments and PDF labels, domestic price estimates, route checks, clients and addresses, and the address classifier with post offices and opening hours. Creating and deleting shipments installed switched off. Contract bearers and counterparty token.
instructions:
## Ukrposhta
This connector works with the **Ukrposhta API** (Укрпошта, the national postal operator of Ukraine) at `https://www.ukrposhta.ua` for business customers with an API contract: tracking, shipments and their labels, price estimates, clients and addresses, and the address classifier (regions, localities, streets, postcodes and post offices). Creating and deleting shipments is installed switched off.

**Setup**
1. Sign a contract for the API with Ukrposhta (business customer service, api-support@ukrposhta.ua). With the contract you receive an annex with your production keys.
2. Copy **PRODUCTION BEARER eCom** into `UKRPOSHTA_ECOM_BEARER`, **PRODUCTION BEARER StatusTracking** into `UKRPOSHTA_TRACKING_BEARER` and **PROD_COUNTERPARTY TOKEN** into `UKRPOSHTA_COUNTERPARTY_TOKEN`.

The sandbox keys (SANDBOX ...) do not work here: this connector calls the production host. The eCom bearer also opens the address classifier and the label service; tracking has its own bearer; the counterparty token identifies your account on calls about your clients and shipments.

**Where to start**: `ukrposhta_track_shipment` or `ukrposhta_get_last_status` with a barcode. For the shipments of your account, `ukrposhta_get_shipment_by_barcode` or `ukrposhta_list_sender_shipments` with the sender's client uuid.

**Tracking**: `ukrposhta_track_shipment` (all events), `ukrposhta_get_last_status`, `ukrposhta_get_last_statuses` (up to 50 barcodes) and `ukrposhta_get_shipment_route`. Pass `lang` en for English event names.

**Shipments**: `ukrposhta_get_shipment`, `ukrposhta_get_shipment_by_barcode`, `ukrposhta_list_sender_shipments`, `ukrposhta_get_shipment_lifecycle`, `ukrposhta_list_shipment_groups`, `ukrposhta_list_group_shipments`, and `ukrposhta_get_label` (PDF). Before shipping, `ukrposhta_check_route` and `ukrposhta_calculate_domestic_price` (UAH, without your contract discounts).

**Creating a shipment** follows Ukrposhta's order: `ukrposhta_create_address` for sender and recipient, `ukrposhta_create_client` for each (or reuse them: `ukrposhta_get_client`, `ukrposhta_find_clients_by_phone`, `ukrposhta_get_address`), then `ukrposhta_create_shipment`, then the label. `ukrposhta_create_shipment` and `ukrposhta_delete_shipment` are installed switched off: a created shipment is charged once handed in, and a deleted one cannot be restored. Addresses and clients cost nothing.

**Address classifier**: `ukrposhta_search_regions`, `ukrposhta_search_districts`, `ukrposhta_search_cities`, `ukrposhta_search_streets`, `ukrposhta_get_house_postcode`, `ukrposhta_get_city_by_postcode`, and for post offices `ukrposhta_find_post_offices_by_postcode`, `ukrposhta_find_post_offices_near` and `ukrposhta_get_post_office_hours`. Answers come as `Entries.Entry` lists with upper-case field names; ids are strings.

**Units and pitfalls**: weight in grams, sizes in cm, money in UAH. Delivery types: W2W post office to post office, W2D to the door, D2W and D2D from the door. A postcode marked `RESTRICTED_ACCESS` can only be a sender or return address. Statuses: CREATED (not handed in yet), REGISTERED, DELIVERING, IN_DEPARTMENT (waiting at the office), DELIVERED, RETURNING, RETURNED, CANCELLED, DELETED. Times are Kyiv local time.

UKRPOSHTA_ECOM_BEARER.label: eCom bearer
UKRPOSHTA_ECOM_BEARER.help: PRODUCTION BEARER eCom from the annex to your Ukrposhta API contract (a UUID).
UKRPOSHTA_ECOM_BEARER.patternMessage: Paste the bearer UUID only (8-4-4-4-12 characters), without the word Bearer.

UKRPOSHTA_TRACKING_BEARER.label: Status tracking bearer
UKRPOSHTA_TRACKING_BEARER.help: PRODUCTION BEARER StatusTracking from the same annex (a UUID, different from the eCom bearer).
UKRPOSHTA_TRACKING_BEARER.patternMessage: Paste the bearer UUID only (8-4-4-4-12 characters), without the word Bearer.

UKRPOSHTA_COUNTERPARTY_TOKEN.label: Counterparty token
UKRPOSHTA_COUNTERPARTY_TOKEN.help: PROD_COUNTERPARTY TOKEN (user token) from the same annex. It identifies your account on calls about your clients and shipments.
UKRPOSHTA_COUNTERPARTY_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the token UUID only (8-4-4-4-12 characters).

verifyHints.401: Ukrposhta refused the bearer. Check that you pasted the production eCom bearer (not the sandbox one) from your contract annex, and the StatusTracking bearer for tracking.
verifyHints.403: Ukrposhta refused the call: the counterparty token does not match the bearer, or your contract does not include this service. Ask your Ukrposhta manager or api-support@ukrposhta.ua.
verifyHints.404: Ukrposhta found no shipment, client or address with that id or barcode in your account.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Ukrposhta is limiting the requests. Wait a little and try again with fewer calls.

prerequisites: A business contract with Ukrposhta for API access; the annex lists the production eCom bearer, StatusTracking bearer and counterparty token. Partner-only: there is no open sign-up.

tools.name: ukrposhta_track_shipment
tools.description: Full status history of one shipment by barcode: per event step, date, index and name of the post office, event code and eventName (e.g. Acceptance, Arrival, Delivered), eventReason, country and mailType. Read-only.

barcode.description: Shipment barcode (tracking number), e.g. 0500100031143 or RA067022855UA.

lang.description: en for English event names. Leave it out for Ukrainian.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_last_status
tools.description: The latest status of one shipment by barcode: date, post office index and name, event code, eventName and eventReason. Read-only.

barcode.description: Shipment barcode (tracking number), e.g. 0500100031143 or RA067022855UA.

lang.description: en for English event names. Leave it out for Ukrainian.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_last_statuses
tools.description: The latest status of up to 50 shipments at once, plus the barcodes Ukrposhta does not know: per barcode date, post office, event code and eventName. Read-only.

lang.description: en for English event names. Leave it out for Ukrainian.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_shipment_route
tools.description: Where a shipment travels from and to (country and locality) by barcode. Read-only.

barcode.description: Shipment barcode (tracking number), e.g. 0500100031143 or RA067022855UA.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_shipment
tools.description: Read one shipment of your account by uuid: barcode, type, sender and recipient clients with addresses, deliveryType, parcels (weight, length, declaredPrice), postPay, deliveryPrice and calculationDescription, paidByRecipient, lifecycle status (CREATED, REGISTERED, DELIVERING, IN_DEPARTMENT, DELIVERED, RETURNING, RETURNED, CANCELLED, DELETED) and deliveryDate. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_shipment_by_barcode
tools.description: Read one shipment of your account by its barcode (same fields as ukrposhta_get_shipment). Read-only.

barcode.description: Shipment barcode (tracking number), e.g. 0500100031143 or RA067022855UA.

tools.name: ukrposhta_list_sender_shipments
tools.description: List the shipments created for one sender client: uuid, barcode, recipient, deliveryType, parcels, prices and lifecycle status. Read-only.

sender_uuid.description: Sender client uuid (sender.uuid of a shipment, or from ukrposhta_create_client).

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_shipment_lifecycle
tools.description: Current status of one shipment from the eCom side: shipmentUuid, shipmentBarcode, status (CREATED, REGISTERED, DELIVERING, IN_DEPARTMENT, DELIVERED, RETURNING, RETURNED, CANCELLED, DELETED) and statusDate. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_list_shipment_groups
tools.description: List the shipment groups (registers for form 103a) of one client: uuid, name, type, created date, closed flag and number of shipments. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_list_group_shipments
tools.description: List the shipments in one shipment group: uuid, barcode, recipient, parcels, prices and lifecycle status. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_label
tools.description: Download the address label (sticker) of a shipment you created, as a PDF file: 100 x 100 mm by default, or on an A4 or A5 sheet. Printing a label costs nothing; the shipment is paid when handed in. Read-only.

size.description: SIZE_A4 or SIZE_A5 to print on a sheet. Default: 100 x 100 mm label.

tools.name: ukrposhta_calculate_domestic_price
tools.description: Estimate the price of a shipment within Ukraine before creating it: deliveryPrice in UAH, rawDeliveryPrice, postPayDeliveryPrice, returnDeliveryPrice and calculationDescription. Discounts of your contract are only applied at creation. Read-only.

type.description: Service: EXPRESS (Ukrposhta Express), STANDARD (Ukrposhta Standard, default), DOCUMENT or CARGO.

delivery_type.description: W2W post office to post office (default), W2D post office to door, D2W door to post office, D2D door to door.

post_pay.description: Cash on delivery amount in UAH, to include its fee.

tools.name: ukrposhta_check_route
tools.description: Check that Ukrposhta delivers between two postcodes: code (SUCCESS when available), description and mrtps (where the mobile post office of the village stands, 1 = none). Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_client
tools.description: Read one client (sender or recipient) of your account: uuid, type (INDIVIDUAL, PRIVATE_ENTREPRENEUR, COMPANY), name, firstName, lastName, addresses, phones, emails, edrpou or tin, bankAccount and postPayPaymentType. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_find_clients_by_phone
tools.description: Find the clients of your account with a phone number: uuid, name, type, addresses. Read-only.

country.description: Country of the number, ISO alpha-2 (default UA).

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_address
tools.description: Read an address created with ukrposhta_create_address: id, postcode, region, district, city, street, houseNumber, apartmentNumber, country and detailedInfo. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_create_address
tools.description: Create an address to use for a client or a shipment. Only the postcode is required; add street and house for door delivery. Free; answers the address id, which ukrposhta_create_client needs.

tools.name: ukrposhta_create_client
tools.description: Create a client (sender or recipient) on an address from ukrposhta_create_address. Individuals and private entrepreneurs need first_name and last_name, companies need name and edrpou. Free; answers the client uuid used by shipments.

edrpou.description: EDRPOU code of a company, 8 digits.

tin.description: Tax number (RNOKPP) of a private entrepreneur, 10 digits.

external_id.description: Your own id for the client.

tools.name: ukrposhta_create_shipment
tools.description: Create a domestic shipment from a sender client to a recipient client. It gets a barcode and a price, and is charged once handed in at the post office or picked up. Installed switched off. Check the price first with ukrposhta_calculate_domestic_price; print the label with ukrposhta_get_label.

type.description: Service: EXPRESS (Ukrposhta Express), STANDARD (Ukrposhta Standard, default), DOCUMENT or CARGO.

delivery_type.description: W2W post office to post office (default), W2D post office to door, D2W door to post office, D2D door to door.

declared_price.description: Declared value of the parcel in UAH.

post_pay.description: Cash on delivery amount in UAH.

paid_by_recipient.description: true: the recipient pays the delivery.

tools.name: ukrposhta_delete_shipment
tools.description: Delete a shipment that is still in status CREATED (not yet handed in). Cannot be undone. Installed switched off.

tools.name: ukrposhta_find_post_offices_by_postcode
tools.description: Post offices that serve a postcode: ID, PO_SHORT and PO_LONG (name), ADDRESS, PHONE, TYPE_LONG, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, POSTTERMINAL, IS_AUTOMATED, LOCK_EN (active or closed) and the locality. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_find_post_offices_near
tools.description: Post offices near a point, nearest first: ID, name, address, postcode, distance, coordinates and type. Read-only.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_post_office_hours
tools.description: Opening hours of a post office by postcode: per weekday the opening and closing time and breaks. Read-only.

post_office_id.description: Post office ID from ukrposhta_find_post_offices_by_postcode, to pick one office when the postcode has several.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_city_by_postcode
tools.description: The locality, district and region of a postcode, with their ids. Read-only.

lang.description: Language of the names: UA (default) or EN.

tools.name: ukrposhta_search_regions
tools.description: Find regions (oblasts) by part of the name, in Ukrainian or English: REGION_ID, REGION_UA, REGION_EN, KOATUU and KATOTTG codes. Leave both names out to list all regions. Read-only.

region_name.description: Part of the Ukrainian name, e.g. Київ.

region_name_en.description: Part of the English name, e.g. Kyiv.

tools.name: ukrposhta_search_districts
tools.description: Find districts of a region by name: DISTRICT_ID, names in UA and EN, region. Read-only.

lang.description: Language of the names: UA (default) or EN.

fuzzy.description: 1: fuzzy search that tolerates typos. Default 0.

tools.name: ukrposhta_search_cities
tools.description: Find localities by name, optionally within a region and district: CITY_ID, names in UA and EN, type (city, village), district, region and postcodes. Read-only.

city_name.description: Part of the locality name, e.g. Бровари or Brovary.

lang.description: Language of the names: UA (default) or EN.

fuzzy.description: 1: fuzzy search that tolerates typos. Default 0.

tools.name: ukrposhta_search_streets
tools.description: Find streets of a locality by name: STREET_ID, names in UA and EN, street type. Read-only.

lang.description: Language of the names: UA (default) or EN.

fuzzy.description: 1: fuzzy search that tolerates typos. Default 0.

tools.name: ukrposhta_get_house_postcode
tools.description: The postcode of a house on a street: house number and POSTCODE. Read-only.
